representation.name: Gzip CSV head
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - <<'PY' "$(inputs.source.path)"
import gzip, sys, csv
with gzip.open(sys.argv[1], 'rt', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    for i, row in zip(range(6), reader):
        print('ROW', i, 'NCOL', len(row))
        print('\t'.join(row[:25]))
PY
